title: Bigger of Two
goal: Return the larger argument. The if needs to be the value, not a statement.

choices.text: if a > b { a } else { b }
if a > b { a; } else { b; }

hints: `a > b` is a bool. The function promises an i32.
Semicolons inside the branches turn values into statements.
explanation: `a > b` alone returns a `bool` where an `i32` was promised (E0308). Wrapping it in an if expression whose branches are bare values - `if a > b { a } else { b }` - makes the comparison choose the return value. Add semicolons inside the branches and both produce `()`, back to E0308. The call site must also pass exactly two i32 arguments.
